title: Supplementary information exchanges need approved agreements and review records
remediation: The sponsor interconnection owner and information custodians inventory assessed exchanges and approved agreement types. Review a scoped agreement for interfaces, privacy and security expectations, assigned responsibilities and review cadence. Match the approved agreement to a redacted deployed connection record and record a dated renewal, closure or gap.

milestones.title: Collect approved exchange scope, the applicable agreement and review cadence, and a sampled operating and review record
